test_cases.scenario: Teams page loads for authenticated user with view permission
test_cases.steps: Log in as a user with teams.view_team permission. Navigate to /teams/.
test_cases.expected: Page loads successfully. Team list table is visible. No errors in browser console.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated user is redirected to login
test_cases.steps: Log out. Navigate directly to /teams/.
test_cases.expected: User is redirected to /login/. Teams page is not accessible.

test_cases.scenario: Add button is visible only for user with add_team permission
test_cases.steps: Log in as user with teams.add_team permission. Navigate to /teams/.
test_cases.expected: Add Team button is visible in the page header.

test_cases.scenario: Add button is hidden for user without add_team permission
test_cases.steps: Log in as user without teams.add_team permission. Navigate to /teams/.
test_cases.expected: Add Team button is not visible on the page.

test_cases.scenario: Import button is visible only for user with import_team permission
test_cases.steps: Log in as user with teams.import_team permission. Navigate to /teams/.
test_cases.expected: Import button is visible on the page.

test_cases.scenario: Export button is visible only for user with export_team permission
test_cases.steps: Log in as user with teams.export_team permission. Navigate to /teams/.
test_cases.expected: Export button is visible on the page.

test_cases.scenario: Edit and delete actions are hidden for user without change/delete permission
test_cases.steps: Log in as user with only teams.view_team permission. Navigate to /teams/. Inspect table row actions.
test_cases.expected: No edit or delete action buttons are visible on team rows.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned. Response body contains a structured error.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without view_team returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/ with a valid Bearer token for a user who does not have teams.view_team permission.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Default list returns only active teams
test_cases.steps: Ensure both active and inactive teams exist. Send GET /api/v1/teams/ with a valid Bearer token and view_team permission.
test_cases.expected: Response contains only active teams (is_active=true). Inactive teams are not included.

test_cases.scenario: Response includes standard pagination envelope
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Response body contains: success, message, data.results (array), data.pagination with total_count, total_pages, current_page, page_size, has_next, has_previous.

test_cases.scenario: Search by name returns matching teams only
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/?search=Engineering with a valid token. At least one team with 'Engineering' in its name exists.
test_cases.expected: Only teams whose name contains 'Engineering' (case-insensitive) are returned.

test_cases.scenario: Search with no matches returns empty results
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/?search=ZZZNOMATCH with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: results is an empty array. pagination.total_count is 0.

test_cases.scenario: is_active=false filter returns inactive teams
test_cases.steps: Ensure at least one inactive team exists. Send GET /api/v1/teams/?is_active=false with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Response contains only inactive teams (is_active=false).

test_cases.scenario: Sort by name ascending
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/?sort=name&order_by=ASC with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Teams are returned in alphabetical order A→Z by name.

test_cases.scenario: Sort by name descending
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/?sort=name&order_by=DESC with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Teams are returned in reverse alphabetical order Z→A by name.

test_cases.scenario: Sort by created_at
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/?sort=created_at&order_by=ASC with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Teams are returned ordered oldest-first by creation date.

test_cases.scenario: Pagination: page and page_size params work
test_cases.steps: Ensure more than 5 teams exist. Send GET /api/v1/teams/?page=1&page_size=2 with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Exactly 2 teams are returned. pagination.page_size is 2. pagination.has_next is true if more teams exist.

test_cases.scenario: page_size is capped at 100
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/?page_size=999 with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: At most 100 results are returned. No error is raised.

test_cases.scenario: Empty list returns valid paginated response
test_cases.steps: Ensure no active teams exist. Send GET /api/v1/teams/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: results is an empty array. pagination.total_count is 0. HTTP 200.

test_cases.scenario: Response fields match list serializer schema
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Each team object in results contains: code, name, description, is_active, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by.

test_cases.scenario: Default ordering is alphabetical by name
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/ with no sort param.
test_cases.expected: Teams are returned in ascending alphabetical order by name.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/TEAM-0001/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without view_team returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/TEAM-0001/ with a valid token for a user without teams.view_team.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Valid code returns team detail with all fields
test_cases.steps: Ensure a team exists with a known code. Send GET /api/v1/teams/<code>/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response data contains: code, name, description, is_active, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by.

test_cases.scenario: Unknown code returns 404
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/UNKNOWN-9999/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 404. Response body contains a structured error message. No stack trace is exposed.

test_cases.scenario: Inactive team is retrievable by code
test_cases.steps: Ensure an inactive team exists with a known code. Send GET /api/v1/teams/<code>/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Team is returned with is_active=false.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/ with no Authorization header and a valid JSON body.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without add_team returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/ with a valid token for a user without teams.add_team.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Valid payload creates team and returns 201
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/ with body: {"name": "Engineering", "description": "Core engineering team", "is_active": true}. Include valid Bearer token with add_team permission.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Response contains the created team with code, name, description, is_active=true, created_at, created_by.

test_cases.scenario: Duplicate team name returns 409
test_cases.steps: Create a team named 'Engineering'. Send POST /api/v1/teams/ with the same name again.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 409. Response body contains error indicating a team with that name already exists.

test_cases.scenario: Missing required name field returns 400
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/ with body: {"description": "No name given"}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error response references the name field as required.

test_cases.scenario: Name exceeding 120 characters returns 400
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/ with name set to a 121-character string.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error response indicates name is too long.

test_cases.scenario: Description is optional and defaults to empty string
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/ with body: {"name": "Team Without Desc"}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Created team has description as an empty string.

test_cases.scenario: is_active is optional and defaults to true
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/ with body: {"name": "Team No Active Flag"}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Created team has is_active=true.

test_cases.scenario: Creating team with is_active=false creates inactive team
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/ with body: {"name": "Inactive Team", "is_active": false}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Response shows is_active=false.

test_cases.scenario: Created team appears in list API immediately
test_cases.steps: Create a team via POST. Then send GET /api/v1/teams/ with is_active=true.
test_cases.expected: The newly created team appears in the list results.

test_cases.scenario: created_by is set to the authenticated user
test_cases.steps: Log in as a specific user. Create a team via POST /api/v1/teams/. Retrieve the team with GET /api/v1/teams/<code>/.
test_cases.expected: created_by in the response reflects the user who made the create request.

test_cases.scenario: Name with exactly 120 characters is accepted
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/ with name set to exactly 120 characters.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Team is created successfully.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send PATCH /api/v1/teams/<code>/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without change_team returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send PATCH /api/v1/teams/<code>/ with a valid token for a user without teams.change_team.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Valid partial update of name returns updated team
test_cases.steps: Send PATCH /api/v1/teams/<code>/ with body: {"name": "Updated Name"}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response shows the updated name. Other fields are unchanged.

test_cases.scenario: Updating description returns updated value
test_cases.steps: Send PATCH /api/v1/teams/<code>/ with body: {"description": "New description"}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response shows the updated description.

test_cases.scenario: Updating is_active via PATCH works
test_cases.steps: Create an active team. Send PATCH /api/v1/teams/<code>/ with body: {"is_active": false}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response shows is_active=false.

test_cases.scenario: Renaming to a name that belongs to another team returns 409
test_cases.steps: Ensure two teams exist: 'Team A' and 'Team B'. Send PATCH /api/v1/teams/<Team A code>/ with body: {"name": "Team B"}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 409. Error indicates a team with that name already exists.

test_cases.scenario: Updating a team with its own current name does not conflict
test_cases.steps: Send PATCH /api/v1/teams/<code>/ with body: {"name": "<same name as team>"}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Update succeeds. No conflict error is raised.

test_cases.scenario: Updating unknown code returns 404
test_cases.steps: Send PATCH /api/v1/teams/UNKNOWN-9999/ with a valid body and token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 404.

test_cases.scenario: Name longer than 120 characters returns 400
test_cases.steps: Send PATCH /api/v1/teams/<code>/ with name set to 121 characters.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error references name length constraint.

test_cases.scenario: Empty PATCH body succeeds without modifying the team
test_cases.steps: Send PATCH /api/v1/teams/<code>/ with an empty JSON body {}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Team data is unchanged. No error is returned.

test_cases.scenario: updated_by reflects the user who made the update
test_cases.steps: Log in as a specific user. Send PATCH /api/v1/teams/<code>/ with any valid change. Retrieve the team.
test_cases.expected: updated_by in the response reflects the user who performed the update.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send DELETE /api/v1/teams/<code>/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without delete_team returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send DELETE /api/v1/teams/<code>/ with a valid token for a user without teams.delete_team.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Valid delete returns 204
test_cases.steps: Ensure a team with a known code exists. Send DELETE /api/v1/teams/<code>/ with a valid token and delete_team permission.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 204. No response body.

test_cases.scenario: Unknown code returns 404
test_cases.steps: Send DELETE /api/v1/teams/UNKNOWN-9999/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 404. Structured error response is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Deleted team no longer appears in list
test_cases.steps: Create a team. Delete it via DELETE. Then send GET /api/v1/teams/ with is_active filter including both.
test_cases.expected: The deleted team does not appear in any list response.

test_cases.scenario: Retrieve of deleted team returns 404
test_cases.steps: Delete a team. Then send GET /api/v1/teams/<code>/ for the deleted team.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 404.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/<code>/activate/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without change_team returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/<code>/activate/ with a valid token for a user without teams.change_team.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Activating an inactive team sets is_active to true
test_cases.steps: Ensure a team with is_active=false exists. Send POST /api/v1/teams/<code>/activate/ with a valid token and change_team permission.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response shows is_active=true. Team now appears in default list.

test_cases.scenario: Activating an already-active team is a no-op
test_cases.steps: Ensure a team with is_active=true exists. Send POST /api/v1/teams/<code>/activate/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response shows is_active=true. No error is raised.

test_cases.scenario: Activating unknown code returns 404
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/UNKNOWN-9999/activate/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 404.

test_cases.scenario: Activated team appears in default (active-only) list
test_cases.steps: Deactivate a team. Activate it. Send GET /api/v1/teams/.
test_cases.expected: The team appears in the active list results.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/<code>/deactivate/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without change_team returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/<code>/deactivate/ with a valid token for a user without teams.change_team.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Deactivating an active team sets is_active to false
test_cases.steps: Ensure a team with is_active=true exists. Send POST /api/v1/teams/<code>/deactivate/ with a valid token and change_team permission.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response shows is_active=false.

test_cases.scenario: Deactivating an already-inactive team is a no-op
test_cases.steps: Ensure a team with is_active=false exists. Send POST /api/v1/teams/<code>/deactivate/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response shows is_active=false. No error is raised.

test_cases.scenario: Deactivating unknown code returns 404
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/UNKNOWN-9999/deactivate/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 404.

test_cases.scenario: Deactivated team excluded from default list
test_cases.steps: Deactivate a team. Send GET /api/v1/teams/ (default active-only).
test_cases.expected: The deactivated team is not included in the results.

test_cases.scenario: Deactivated team appears when filtering is_active=false
test_cases.steps: Deactivate a team. Send GET /api/v1/teams/?is_active=false.
test_cases.expected: The deactivated team appears in the results.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/stats/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without view_team returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/stats/ with a valid token for a user without teams.view_team.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Statistics returns total, active, and inactive counts
test_cases.steps: Ensure a known set of active and inactive teams exists. Send GET /api/v1/teams/stats/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response contains total, active, and inactive counts that match the current state.

test_cases.scenario: Statistics are accurate after create and deactivate operations
test_cases.steps: Note current stats. Create one active team and deactivate one existing team. Send GET /api/v1/teams/stats/ again.
test_cases.expected: total increases by 1, active changes reflect operations, inactive count updates accordingly.

test_cases.scenario: fields param returns only requested stat keys
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/stats/?fields=active,inactive with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response contains only the active and inactive keys, not total.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/import/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without import_team returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/import/ with a valid token for a user without teams.import_team.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Valid CSV with header and data rows imports successfully
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV file with header row 'name,description,is_active' and two valid data rows. Send POST /api/v1/teams/import/ with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 207. Response shows created_rows list with both teams. errors is empty. Teams are visible in GET /api/v1/teams/.

test_cases.scenario: No file uploaded returns 400
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/import/ with a valid token but no file in the request body.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error indicates no import file was uploaded.

test_cases.scenario: Non-CSV file returns 400
test_cases.steps: Upload a .xlsx or .txt file to POST /api/v1/teams/import/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error indicates unsupported file format and lists allowed formats.

test_cases.scenario: Missing required 'name' column in CSV returns 400
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV file with only a 'description' column header (no 'name' column). Send POST /api/v1/teams/import/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error indicates the 'name' column is missing.

test_cases.scenario: Row with blank name is skipped and reported in errors
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV with one valid row and one row where name is blank. Send POST /api/v1/teams/import/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 207. The valid row is created. The blank-name row appears in errors with field=name and a message about name being required.

test_cases.scenario: Row with name exceeding 120 characters is skipped and reported in errors
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV with a row where name is 121 characters. Send POST /api/v1/teams/import/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 207. The oversized name row appears in errors. No team is created for that row.

test_cases.scenario: Row with duplicate team name is skipped and reported in errors
test_cases.steps: Ensure a team named 'Engineering' already exists. Upload a CSV containing a row with name='Engineering'. Send POST /api/v1/teams/import/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 207. The duplicate row appears in errors. No new team is created for that row.

test_cases.scenario: File exceeding 5 MB size limit returns 400
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV file larger than 5 MB. Send POST /api/v1/teams/import/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error indicates the file is too large and shows the maximum allowed size.

test_cases.scenario: File with more than 1000 data rows returns 400
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV file with 1001 data rows. Send POST /api/v1/teams/import/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error indicates too many rows and shows the maximum allowed.

test_cases.scenario: Dry run (validate=true) previews result without creating teams
test_cases.steps: Upload a valid CSV. Send POST /api/v1/teams/import/?validate=true.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 207. Response shows dry_run=true, created_rows previewed, but no teams are actually created. GET /api/v1/teams/ does not show any new teams.

test_cases.scenario: CSV row with is_active=false creates an inactive team
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV with a row: name='Inactive Team',description='',is_active=false.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 207. The team is created. GET /api/v1/teams/?is_active=false confirms it as inactive.

test_cases.scenario: CSV row with only name column creates team with default values
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV with header 'name' only and a row with just a team name.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 207. Team is created. description defaults to empty string, is_active defaults to true.

test_cases.scenario: GET /api/v1/teams/import/specs/ returns field definitions and limits
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/import/specs/ with a valid token and import_team permission.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response contains supported_formats, max_rows (1000), max_file_size_mb (5), fields array describing name/description/is_active, and notes array.

test_cases.scenario: GET /api/v1/teams/import/sample/ downloads a CSV template
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/import/sample/ with a valid token and import_team permission.
test_cases.expected: Response is a CSV file download (teams_import_template.csv) with header row: name,description,is_active and a sample data row.

test_cases.scenario: Import response includes accurate total row count
test_cases.steps: Upload a CSV with 5 rows (3 valid, 1 duplicate, 1 blank name). Send POST /api/v1/teams/import/.
test_cases.expected: Response total is 5. created_rows has 3 entries. errors has 2 entries.

test_cases.scenario: Unauthenticated request returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/export/ with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Authenticated user without export_team returns 403
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/export/ with a valid token for a user without teams.export_team.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 403 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Export as CSV returns a downloadable CSV file
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/export/?type=csv with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Response content-type is text/csv. File is downloadable. Contains a header row and data rows for all active teams.

test_cases.scenario: Export as XLSX returns a downloadable Excel file
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/export/?type=xlsx with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Response is an XLSX file. It can be opened in Excel/Google Sheets and contains team data.

test_cases.scenario: Export as PDF returns a downloadable PDF file
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/export/?type=pdf with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Response is a PDF file. It contains teams data in a readable format.

test_cases.scenario: Export as JSON returns a downloadable JSON file
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/export/?type=json with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Response is a JSON file containing team records.

test_cases.scenario: Unsupported export format returns 400
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/export/?type=xml with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error indicates unsupported format and lists allowed values: csv, xlsx, pdf, json.

test_cases.scenario: fields param filters exported columns
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/export/?type=csv&fields=name,code with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Exported CSV contains only 'name' and 'code' columns. Other columns are absent.

test_cases.scenario: Default export includes only active teams
test_cases.steps: Ensure both active and inactive teams exist. Send GET /api/v1/teams/export/?type=csv with no is_active filter.
test_cases.expected: Exported file contains only active teams.

test_cases.scenario: is_active=all exports both active and inactive teams
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/export/?type=csv&is_active=all with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Exported CSV contains both active and inactive teams.

test_cases.scenario: search filter in export matches list filter behavior
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/export/?type=csv&search=Engineering with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: Exported file contains only teams whose name matches 'Engineering'.

test_cases.scenario: GET /api/v1/teams/export/specs/ returns available column definitions
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/export/specs/ with a valid token and export_team permission.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Response contains a columns array with entries for name, code, description, is_active, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, each with key, label, and default.

test_cases.scenario: Export with no matching teams returns file with headers only
test_cases.steps: Apply a search filter that matches no teams. Send GET /api/v1/teams/export/?type=csv&search=ZZZNOMATCH.
test_cases.expected: Exported CSV contains the header row only, no data rows.

test_cases.scenario: Default exported columns match export specs default=true columns
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/export/?type=csv with no fields param.
test_cases.expected: Exported CSV headers match the columns where default=true in export specs: name, code, description, is_active, created_at.

test_cases.scenario: All team endpoints require a valid Bearer token
test_cases.steps: Send requests to all endpoints (list, retrieve, create, update, delete, activate, deactivate, stats, import, export) with no Authorization header.
test_cases.expected: All return HTTP 401. No endpoint is accessible without authentication.

test_cases.scenario: Invalid Bearer token returns 401
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/ with Authorization: Bearer invalidtoken123.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 401 is returned.

test_cases.scenario: Correct permission is enforced per endpoint
test_cases.steps: Use a user with only view_team. Try POST /api/v1/teams/ (create), PATCH (update), DELETE, activate, deactivate, import, export.
test_cases.expected: All write/import/export endpoints return HTTP 403. Only list, retrieve, and stats succeed.

test_cases.scenario: Error responses do not expose internal stack traces
test_cases.steps: Trigger a 404 and a 400 error on any team endpoint.
test_cases.expected: Error response contains only code and message. No stack trace, SQL query, or internal file path is visible.

test_cases.scenario: Response fields do not include unexpected sensitive data
test_cases.steps: Retrieve any team via GET /api/v1/teams/<code>/.
test_cases.expected: Response contains only documented fields: code, name, description, is_active, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by. No internal IDs, raw DB fields, or system fields are exposed.

test_cases.scenario: Audit log is created on create, update, delete, activate, deactivate
test_cases.steps: Perform create, update, delete, activate, and deactivate operations on a team. Check the audit log (if accessible via API or admin).
test_cases.expected: Each operation generates an audit record with the correct module, resource type, resource code, before/after state, and actor.

test_cases.scenario: Team name with special characters is accepted
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/ with name: 'R&D / Infra (Beta)'.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Team is created and the name is stored exactly as provided.

test_cases.scenario: Team name with unicode characters is accepted
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/ with name containing unicode characters, e.g. 'Équipe Développement'.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Team is created with the unicode name intact.

test_cases.scenario: Team name with exactly 120 characters (boundary) is accepted
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/ with a name of exactly 120 characters.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Team is created successfully.

test_cases.scenario: Team name with 121 characters (boundary +1) is rejected
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/ with a name of exactly 121 characters.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 400. Error references name length constraint.

test_cases.scenario: Description can be an empty string on create
test_cases.steps: Send POST /api/v1/teams/ with body: {"name": "Team X", "description": ""}.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 201. Team created with empty description.

test_cases.scenario: Description can be set to empty string on update
test_cases.steps: Create a team with a non-empty description. Then PATCH it with description: ''.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Updated team has empty description.

test_cases.scenario: Sorting by an unsupported field does not crash the API
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/?sort=nonexistent_field with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Returns teams with default ordering. No 500 error.

test_cases.scenario: page=0 is treated as page 1
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/?page=0 with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Returns the first page of results. No error.

test_cases.scenario: Non-numeric page or page_size is handled gracefully
test_cases.steps: Send GET /api/v1/teams/?page=abc&page_size=xyz with a valid token.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 200. Falls back to default page=1, page_size=25. No error.

test_cases.scenario: Importing a CSV with BOM encoding is handled correctly
test_cases.steps: Save a CSV file with UTF-8 BOM encoding. Upload it via POST /api/v1/teams/import/.
test_cases.expected: HTTP 207. BOM is stripped. Teams are created correctly. No column name error.

test_cases.scenario: Concurrent create requests with the same name results in only one team created
test_cases.steps: Simultaneously send two POST /api/v1/teams/ requests with the same team name.
test_cases.expected: One request succeeds with HTTP 201. The other returns HTTP 409. Only one team with that name exists in the system.
